text:
jordan: PTAL — draft PRD for Chat/Completions acceptance criteria + edge cases. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-PRD-chat-completions-draft (draft). Need signoff for EOW. Key asks: gating tests, fallback behavior, logging/privacy, and explicit reranker contract for chat.

maya: reading now. can we add explicit rollout gate: 0.1% canary -> perf smoke -> 1% -> 5% -> 100%? ML rollbacks auto on quality drop? also need SLA numbers.

sam: quick question — streaming semantics: does the acceptance test require a `final` flag when chunking? we should define behavior for truncated responses and reconnects.

liam: reranker contract: when chat flow calls rerank, we need deterministic sorted IDs when seed provided. Also define tie-breaker: timestamp asc. Also return scores normalized 0-1.

eva: security note — prompts stored only for 30 days in prod; must be opt-out for enterprise. KMS must be enforced for Private. Add acceptance test that ensures PII redaction header honored.

jordan: good points. adding snippet for acceptance tests:

```yaml
acceptance_tests:
  - name: latency_smoke
    p95_latency_ms: 350
    qps: 100
    duration_s: 120
  - name: fallback_behavior
    on_model_error:
      action: fallback
      target: "model-slim"
      max_switch_ms: 200
  - name: streaming_semantics
    final_flag: "final_chunk=true"
    reconnect_behavior: "resume_kv_cache"
  - name: rerank_contract
    scores_range: [0.0, 1.0]
    deterministic_with_seed: true
    tie_breaker: "timestamp_asc"
  - name: privacy
    prompt_retention_days: 30
    enterprise_opt_out: true
```

maya: acceptance criteria look good. add perf target: p95 latency < 350ms for 1-ctx token on m60-like pods. Also throughput smoke test: 100 qps sustained for 2m.

sam: edgecases: 1) empty messages array -> 400? 2) too-long context -> 413 + partial KV cache eviction policy documented. 3) model-failure -> 503 + fallback to slim-model within 200ms.

liam: embeddings note — batch API must preserve order, include request_id in response for mapping. tests to assert order for batch sizes up to 512.

qa-bot: checklist added: [ ] unit tests, [ ] e2e smoke (latency), [ ] security review, [ ] docs updated, [ ] SDK change log. Added ticket: INF-4573.

maya: can we centralize fallback policy names? e.g., `fallback: model-slim` string in response metadata. need example.

jordan: yep I'll add response metadata example. @sam @liam please review the code block for wording. If no objections by 5pm I'll merge to PRD and create rollout playbook.

sam: looks fine from infra side. one nit: change `deterministic_topK` -> `deterministic_ranking_with_seed`.

liam: +1

maya: :thumbsup:

jordan: thanks everyone. launching review board on Thursday. end thread.
